thread:
Elaine: quick handoff — observed repeated pages for embeddings queue (eu-west) starting ~40m ago. primary pod (prim-sec-1) is showing KV eviction spikes and high GC; p99 infer latency ~2.3s, error rate small but customers A/B experiencing 502s. I started a few mitigations, but handing off so someone can keep watch and escalate.
Ben: ok saw the alerts. which mitigations are live and what's next? any customer-facing work? :eyes:
Elaine: live mitigations:
- scaled embeddings-workers by +2 nodes (temporary)
- enabled routing fallback to quantized small-embed model for non-SLA traffic
- forced warm of prefix cache for hot keys (see command below)
- 5m autoscale override set to 60% (was 40%)
Customer impact: small percentage (~0.8%) of embedding requests in eu-west getting 5xx; major customers mostly degraded latency not full outage.
Command I ran (effects verified via metrics):
```
# warm top hot keys
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/services/embeddings/cache/warm" -d '{"keys": ["kb:top:123","kb:top:456"]}'
kubectl scale deployment embeddings-workers --replicas=12 -n eu-west
``` 
Ajay: noted. runbook link? and do we need to open an incident? pager shows current severity as SEV-2 (paging still going out)
Elaine: runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-eviction (see section "prim/secondary swap and warming"). Pagerduty created a short incident: PD-34821. IncidentBot logged initial alert.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty PD-34821 triggered by Alertmanager: embeddings-queue-eu: p99_latency > 2s, error_rate > 0.5%.
Marta: I'm seconding coverage for the night. I'll watch metrics and logs, and I'll take the prim->sec swap if you want me to proceed now.
Elaine: please proceed, Marta. My notes for swap:
- follow runbook step 3.2 (safe prim->sec switchover)
- ensure KV cache copy is warmed on target
- after swap, monitor p50/p95/p99 and error rate for 10m; if errors spike, rollback to original and apply fallback routing to small model permanently until we stabilize.
Marta: doing the swap now. I'll post timeline + checks. ETA ~3m.
Ben: I'll keep customer comms ready; if this drifts >30m we'll send a short status to affected accounts. Also toggling verbose logs for embeddings to capture request IDs.
Ajay: leaving a quick troubleshooting checklist here:
- check node-level OOM / GC spikes: `kubectl top nodes` and container logs `/var/log/embeddings/*`
- check KV eviction metrics: redis evict count, cache hit ratio
- check routing table to ensure fallback paths are enabled (svc-routing service)
- if prim swap fails, enable global rate-shedding for non-critical traffic: `config rate_shed: non_sla=0.2`
Marta: swap complete. verified prim role moved to prim-sec-2, warmed cache present. p99 down to ~1.1s, error rate dropping. continuing to monitor.
Elaine: great. continuing mitigations in progress:
- keep autoscale override for another 15m
- leave fallback routing enabled for low-priority traffic for 30m
- capture example request IDs for postmortem
If anything changes ping me and @Ben, I'll stay reachable for the next 45m then fully handoff.
Ben: noted. I'll be primary watcher for escalation. If we see new pages escalate to SEV-1.
Ajay: I'll prepare perf traces and a short postmortem skeleton (cause hypothesis: KV eviction due to uneven shard hot keys + under-provisioned prim). Will collect traces and embed into PD-34821.
IncidentBot: PD-34821 updated: status=mitigated -> monitoring. Note: alerts suppressed for 10m due to autoscale override.
Marta: observed a small tail of increased latency at p99 for a particular keyspace; created a short temp rule to prefetch that keyspace. continuing to watch.
Elaine: handoff summary: primary -> Marta (active), Ben (esc), Ajay (postmortem traces), Elaine (on-call until 45m) — mitigations: scale +2, prim swap done, fallback routing enabled, cache warms; runbook referenced. Leaving this thread open; please post any status updates here only. :thumbsup:
Ben: echo — will send status to impacted customers at T+30m if metrics not fully normalized.
Marta: ok marking monitoring flag, will update every 10m or on change.
notes: handoff for active embeddings queue incident in eu-west; participants included oncall staff and incident bots. Contains runbook link and commands used.
